title: Compositional Dynamics in Learning and Mechanics
abstract: arXiv:2606.28984v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We give a single compositional setting in which gradient-based learning and Hamiltonian-style mechanics appear as functorial semantics. The syntax is an operad Arr whose objects are input-output interfaces (pairs of manifolds) and whose morphisms are *smooth adaptive arrangements*, which consist of a responsive parameter space, a lens given by smooth output and input maps, and a real-valued potential.   The main technical result of the paper is what we call *lens internalization*, a lax symmetric monoidal functor Lens(C) $\to$ C associated to any symmetric monoidal closed category C. Using it, we provide two functors $\Phi_\text{phase}$, $\Phi_\text{conf}$: Arr $\to$ PC into the 2-category of polynomial coalgebras -- input-output discrete dynamical systems -- which we take as the semantics category. $\Phi_\text{phase}$ stores both position and momentum, whereas $\Phi_\text{conf}$ stores only position. translated_title: 学习与力学中的组合动力学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.28984v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们给出了一个单一的组合框架，在该框架中，基于梯度的学习和哈密顿式力学表现为函子语义。其语法是一个操作体Arr，其对象是输入-输出接口（流形对），其态射是*光滑自适应排列*，包括一个响应参数空间、一个由光滑输出和输入映射给出的透镜，以及一个实值势函数。本文的主要技术结果是我们所称的*透镜内化*，即与任何对称幺半闭范畴C相关联的松弛对称幺半函子Lens(C) → C。利用它，我们提供了两个函子Φ_phase、Φ_conf: Arr → PC，进入多项式余代数的2-范畴——输入-输出离散动力系统——我们将其作为语义范畴。Φ_phase存储位置和动量，而Φ_conf仅存储位置。当应用于一个参数化结构时，这两个函子分别捕捉了完整动力学和构型动力学。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一组合框架，通过透镜内化将梯度学习和哈密顿力学表示为函子语义，并给出两个函子分别捕捉完整和构型动力学。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified compositional framework where gradient-based learning and Hamiltonian mechanics appear as functorial semantics via lens internalization, with two functors capturing full and configurational dynamics.
